ABOUT.TITLE: About Our Temple
ABOUT.PARA1: Muktai Devi Temple is a sacred pilgrimage site that offers spiritual peace and divine blessings to devotees. Located at three holy places – Muktainagar, Kothali, and Pandharpur, our temples attract thousands of devotees.
ABOUT.PARA2: By the grace of the Goddess, our temples conduct daily pujas, aartis, and various religious programs.

ABOUT_US.TITLE: About Us
ABOUT_US.SUBTITLE: History and Spiritual Significance of Shri Muktai Devi Temple
ABOUT_US.HISTORY_PARA_1: The history of Muktai Devi Temple spans hundreds of years. Muktai Devi was the revered mother of Sant Eknath Maharaj. Due to her devotion and purity, she became worshipped as a form of the Goddess.
ABOUT_US.HISTORY_PARA_2: Born in Paithan, Muktai inspired Sant Eknath Maharaj on the path of spirituality. Through her blessings, Sant Eknath Maharaj performed many miracles and brought about social reforms in society.
ABOUT_US.SPIRITUAL_PARA_1: Devotees who worship Goddess Muktai attain mental peace, family happiness, and spiritual growth. Her divine blessings remove obstacles and bring positivity into life.
ABOUT_US.SPIRITUAL_PARA_2: Especially for women, Goddess Muktai stands as an ideal. Her life of sacrifice, dedication, and devotion is an inspiration for everyone.

MUKTAINAGAR.TITLE: Muktainagar
MUKTAINAGAR.DESCRIPTION: The main temple of Muktai Devi, providing spiritual refuge to devotees for hundreds of years.

KOTHALI.DESCRIPTION: The sacred temple at Kothali, known for its peaceful ambiance and divine presence.
